author: evaluation-proof v9 authoring lane (EP8 successor; C-2 v4 re-pin and delegation-closure widening)
role: Re-pin the evaluation-proof C-2 authority join onto the repaired, independently reviewed C-2 v4 bytes, and bring the entire ten-member delegation closure inside one pinned, hash-verified, executed-from-snapshot, measured window. EP9 moves no proof identity: every vector, commitment, raw receipt byte, RawCasRef, semantic ref, derived requirement and policy verdict is byte-value identical to EP8.

repairs.title: Re-pin the C-2 authority join onto the repaired C-2 v4 bytes
repairs.defect: check-c2.py (4f31d57c...) guarded both commitment-bearing schemaVersion fields with a bare inequality against the integer 1. True == 1 and 1.0 == 1 in the host language, so validate_plan_intent ADMITTED a wire PlanIntent spelling schemaVersion as JSON true and the encoder committed it to a SECOND digest, and ADMITTED one spelling it as JSON 1.0 and then raised an unguarded ValueError inside the encoder. check-evaluation-proof-v6.py pins those exact bytes and calls validate_plan_intent -> plan_intent_commitment -> canonical_plan_intent at lines 359-364 of admit_evaluation_authority; EP7 loads EP6 and EP8 loads EP7, so the whole chain inherited it.
repairs.closure: v9 pins c2-plan-stage-schema.v4.json and check-c2-v4.py directly and is the authority for the C-2 join. The three imported APIs are verified against the repaired bytes for presence, callability and arity, and are then proved load-bearing by an executed LB-C2-01 battery whose positive control is the superseded instrument itself.

repairs.title: Bring the whole delegation closure inside the pinned, verified set
repairs.defect: ep8-rt13.review-independent-cold-reconstruction.json names check-evaluation-proof-v7.py and names check-evaluation-proof-v6.py, check-c2.py and c2-plan-stage-schema.v3.json zero times. There are no standalone v6 or v7 reviews, and neither v8 nor v7 mentions check-c2 or validate_plan_intent anywhere in its source. EP8's PASS never reached the hop carrying the defect.
repairs.closure: All ten closure executables are pinned by exact SHA-256, hash-verified before execution, and executed from the verified byte string with no second disk read. Every predecessor's own declared pin table is read back out of the executed module object and required to agree with v9's digit for digit, so the internal loads EP8/EP7/EP6/C-2 v4 perform are shown to bind the same bytes rather than assumed to. Every pinned data input is recorded by digest as data, per IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE 7.2: a count is not a record.

repairs.title: Prove expectedPlanIntentCommitment unmoved by recomputation
repairs.defect: A re-pin onto a different C-2 instrument could silently move a commitment, and copying the EP8 literal forward would conceal exactly that.
repairs.closure: No declared commitment is trusted. Each is recomputed through C-2 v4, recomputed again under the superseded encoder as an independent cross-check, and compared against the value EP8 committed. Preimages are compared as BYTES, not merely digests, so a collision cannot explain agreement. A moved commitment is reported as EP9-COMMITMENT-MOVED and named a MAJOR finding that must not be absorbed.

repairs.title: Publish measured scalar-leaf totality
repairs.defect: IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE 7 records six surfaces that shipped a coverage or totality claim quantified over a region their own instrument could not observe. One is C-2's 4x4 matrix, pinned never to reach a scalar leaf, which is exactly where LB-C2-01 lived.
repairs.closure: Every measured surface is enumerated at the root, every object key and every array index at unlimited depth, container AND scalar leaf alike; hostile values are injected at each position; and the published counts are the live census, recomputed and compared on every run. Understating the space is a finding, not an omission.

repairs.title: Refuse the AST self-scan as a sole guard, and measure its blind spot
repairs.defect: EV10-IR-01 and IR-C2V4-01 both defeated this scan class constructively by module alias, local alias, getattr(sys.modules[__name__], ...), dispatch table, inner function, comprehension, walrus, tuple-unpack and class method. C-2 v4 passed anyway only because an independent behavioural layer caught every evasion.
repairs.closure: The scan is declared a tripwire, never the guard. All nine evasion variants are built and executed on every run; the number the syntactic scan misses is published as measured, however unflattering; and the independent behavioural layer - the LB-C2-01 battery and the Authority.c2v4 access counter, neither of which reads source - is required to catch every one.

repairs.title: Keep --selftest genuinely live and distinguishable
repairs.defect: The evidence.v8 defect: main() returned at the findings branch before the mutation suite, so normal and --selftest produced byte-identical output and the suite never executed.
repairs.closure: --selftest produces output distinct from a normal run; a dirty base exits 3 with an explicit SELFTEST-REFUSED / SELFTEST-NOT-RUN refusal, distinct from green 0, findings 1 and bad invocation 2; and an AST reachability scan requires exactly one flag-guarded dispatch to selftest(), positioned before any findings return in main().

repairs.title: Totality: hostile parsed JSON yields findings, never tracebacks
repairs.defect: A checker that raises on hostile input reports nothing, and a traceback is not a verdict.
repairs.closure: check() is the total boundary over the unguarded _check(). Seven hostile parsed-JSON roots and the full leaf-inclusive contract-root matrix are driven through it under --selftest; zero guarded escapes is required. The unguarded inner-reader raise count is reported rather than suppressed.

repairs.title: stdlib only
repairs.defect: ripgrep is the corpus's only external tool dependency and is a documented problem: check-rust-provider-protocol-v4.py cannot run without it.
repairs.closure: This checker imports ast, copy, hashlib, importlib.util, io, json, pathlib, sys, types and contextlib.redirect_stdout only. No subprocess, no network, no external binary.

repairs.title: One mutation per repair, proving each is load-bearing
repairs.defect: A repair that no mutation can falsify is decorative.
repairs.closure: Every declared repair carries at least one contract or source mutation that must be REJECTED, and the mutation set is required to cover the repair set exactly. Three source mutations attack the instrument itself rather than the document.

RES-EP9-01. v9 does NOT repair check-evaluation-proof-v6.py, which is pinned by passed work and out of scope for edit. EP6's INNER C-2 join still executes against the defective check-c2.py bytes underneath EP8. v9 is a strictly stronger OUTER gate, not a replacement of EP6's internals: it independently re-validates every PlanIntent in the closure through C-2 v4 and refuses anything v4 rejects, so nothing EP6 would silently admit survives a v9 run. Closing the inner join requires a v6 successor and is not closed by this candidate.

RES-EP9-02. The AST tripwire is evadable by the nine indirection classes named in EV10-IR-01 and IR-C2V4-01. This candidate measures that blind spot rather than claiming immunity; the load-bearing guard is the non-AST behavioural layer.

RES-EP9-03. The contract-root hostile matrix is EXECUTED under --selftest only. On an ordinary run the contract-root space is enumerated and its census published, but not driven, because driving it re-entrantly through the measurement layer would multiply the cost by two orders of magnitude.

RES-EP9-05. MEASURED, NOT REPAIRED. The leaf-inclusive instrument found the LB-C2-01 CLASS in the evaluation-proof chain's own guards: EP8's public authorize_evaluation ADMITS a candidate spelling schemaVersion as JSON true or JSON 1.0 at four sites - the candidate root, planAuthorityReceipt, activationManifest and evaluationAuthoritySeal - because those exact-closed-record guards are bare inequalities against the integer 1. On the frozen bytes this moves NO proof identity, because every ref is derived from the stored raw CAS bytes rather than from the in-memory record; it is nonetheless a false accept of a type-distinct value. v9 cannot repair it without editing pinned predecessors, so it enumerates the exact admitted set in scalarLeafTotality.surfaces[evaluation-authority-candidate].admittedPositions and makes any change to that set a finding. Closing it requires v6/v8 successors.

RES-EP9-04. check-completeness.py and check-rust-provider-protocol-v4.py exit 1 for reasons that PRE-EXIST this candidate: open finding R2-FINAL-03, and the absence of an rg binary on PATH. Neither is attributable to EP9 and neither is repaired here.
V10 remains unresolved; CD-RT-5 and G19 remain blocked; candidate is not applied and has no seal/signoff authority.

It does not see a call reached through a module alias, a local alias, getattr, a dispatch table, an inner function, a comprehension, a walrus, a tuple-unpack or a class method.

integerGuardScan.whyItExists: the leaf-inclusive instrument found the LB-C2-01 class in this checker's own first draft: `contract.get("version") != 9` admits JSON 9.0 and `repairAuthorisedByBlockingFindingCount != 0` admits JSON false. A checker that exists to re-pin away from that defect may not carry it.

ownConstantLeafBattery.declaredScope: reads NO source. Every integer and boolean scalar leaf of the candidate is replaced in turn by JSON true, JSON false and JSON 1.0, and the COMPLETE checking layer is re-run. ownConstantLeafBattery.executionWindow: --selftest. The battery re-runs the whole checking layer once per injected leaf; running it on every ordinary invocation would make an ordinary run cost minutes.
ownConstantLeafBattery.excludedLeavesCoveredBy: the evaluation-authority-candidate surface matrix, which drives every one of them through EP8's real public authorize_evaluation, and the contract-root matrix under --selftest
ownConstantLeafBattery.silentlyAdmittedRule: a leaf this checker constrains must produce a finding. A leaf it does not constrain is enumerated here, and the set must match exactly on every selftest, so it can neither grow nor shrink silently.
ownConstantLeafBattery.whatDeliversTheRejection: stated precisely so the count is not over-read. Rejection at a given leaf comes from EITHER a field-specific exact-type guard - every wire-sourced numeric test in this checker routes through exact_int / int_in_range / exact_int_list - OR from the leaf-inclusive contract-root census, which is itself part of the checking layer: a type-distinct value at ANY leaf changes the measured noOpInjections and no longer matches the published count. Both are real detections and both are part of the checker; but this battery measures that SOMETHING rejects each case, not that each individual field carries its own type guard.

astScanScope.measurementRule: all nine variants are BUILT AND EXECUTED on every run. The number the syntactic scan misses is published as measured, however unflattering, because refusing to state it is precisely the coverage claim over an unobserved region this corpus keeps shipping.

--selftest REFUSED over a dirty base. The suite is not an oracle over a candidate that already fails, so 0 of the mutations are executed and the refusal is printed as SELFTEST-REFUSED / SELFTEST-NOT-RUN. This can never be absorbed into a pass.
